technical_and_design_decisions: Implement the new helpers in Go as part of the existing Hyperledger Fabric channel configuration library, reusing current protobuf types and ConfigUpdate computation utilities.

For capability modifications (U5), provide explicit enable/disable toggle functions (e.g., EnableV20ApplicationCapabilities, DisableApplicationCapabilities) instead of arbitrary setters, to prevent unsupported capabilities from being set.

For policy retrieval (U3), implement a single generic helper that locates an organization across application, orderer, and consortium groups and returns its policies without manual parsing by the caller.
For orderer endpoint changes (U1/U2), modify the Endpoint value inside the target orderer organization's config group and rely on existing delta computation to produce a signed ConfigUpdate.
For ACL modifications (U7), operate on the Application configuration's ACLs map via add/remove helpers that keep the config transaction ready for further updates.

For example tests (U8), replace the single end-to-end example with multiple smaller Example functions grouped by domain (orderer, application, org management, MSP, capabilities) and demonstrate each new API within the relevant example.
assumptions: The existing library already supports loading a Config block/transaction and computing a ConfigUpdate, so only higher-level helpers are added.
